svg.title: Final Stage 2 input-size comparison
svg.desc: Two panels compare reference and large-input paired ASan/native ratios for elapsed time and peak resident memory across bisort, mst, perimeter, and tsp, with modern and paper-like ASan profiles. Error bars are sample standard deviations, n=15. The memory panel uses KiB.
svg.text: Same-run ASan/native ratio means; error bars = sample SD; n = 15. Panels use separate y-axis scales.
Mean of 15 same-run ASan/native ratios; n = 15
Mean of 15 same-run ASan/native ratios; n = 15
Ratios are dimensionless. RSS is GNU time maximum resident set, reported with numerator and denominator in KiB.
Sample SD describes the 15 saved runs; it is not a confidence interval or statistical-significance test.
